description: Test suite for the RedisSemanticCache class in the litellm project, covering initialization, cache retrieval, and asynchronous cache retrieval, involving mocking external dependencies like redisvl modules and environment variables.

methods.name: test_redis_semantic_cache_initialization(monkeypatch)

methods.name: test_redis_semantic_cache_get_cache(monkeypatch)
